policy: LRU; 20 slots: original 16-page baseline plus 4 frontier slots; do not flatten to a 1 GiB VM
note: Host transports page bytes and token vectors only; the native opcode122 head worker performs QKV/MLP arithmetic in the guest.

native_block.architecture: six-token 128D three-layer bf16 QKV/MLP head block
native_block.attention: per-query softmax over up to six keys; sqrt(128) scaling
native_block.note: The dedicated worker image owns all six-token attention and MLP arithmetic; the main field driver keeps a single-token compatibility route.
